content: Human-in-the-loop trade approval UX norms: model stages the action, human reviews and approves before execution; approval required when the action is hard to reverse, spends money, or carries compliance risk; the approval surface must show the exact recipient/amount/diff/tool being authorized. Crypto practice: several bots route per-trade approval through Telegram. Hybrid pattern is common - deterministic auto-approval under a notional threshold, human approval above it. OKX Agentic Wallet (Mar 2026) simulates every transaction pre-execution with a plain-language summary plus automatic risk grading.
